post.title: Are there no spaces for more literary writers on Reddit?
post.body_preview:
Seems like everything skews more SFF, Romance, YA, etc. 

Which is totally fine, but not my bag at all...
post.top_comment: Most Reddit [hidden] spaces lean heavily genre-focused and workshop-style so deeper craft talk is just less common. You’ll probably find more of what you’re after in literary or MFA adjacent communities?
